Some leaves are heavily affected while others show early stages. This pattern strongly suggests either Soybean rust or Septoria brown spot.

Let me view the Soybean_rust reference to confirm.

The test image shows:
- Dense, small reddish-brown/orange-brown spots uniformly scattered across the entire leaf surface
- Significant yellowing between lesions
- Multiple leaves affected at different stages

The Soybean rust reference close-up (top-right panel) shows exactly this pattern — small tan-to-brown pustules densely scattered across the leaf surface, matching the test image precisely. The overall field-level yellowing/defoliation also aligns with heavy rust infection.

This matches Soybean rust description: "Small tan to brown and brick red spots on leaves, with pustules forming on the lower leaf surface containing urediniospores; heavily infected leaves turn yellow and plants defoliate prematurely."
